roads.name: County Road 86
words: Sweeping and steady: 17 curves in 3.7 miles.
The 2 miles at the north end are tamer.
The mile at the south end is tamer.
From 139 to 239 ft, with 295 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 93°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.15 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
